titel: We Lowered a Man Into a 300-Year-Old Ship — He Never Came Back | SCP-1734

einzeiler: A 300-year-old grounded British frigate preserves a timeless, inescapable horror below.
kurzfassung: Researchers study an 18th-century British frigate trapped on a beach, encased in an invisible barrier that prevents any physical touch. Inside, a mysterious vertical shaft leads to a terrifying mass of living, entangled crew members from centuries past. Driven by a strange compulsion, personnel eventually step through the opening, joining the timeless void.
stichpunkte: The 18th-century frigate Cordelia sits grounded in sand, perfectly preserved despite being three centuries old.
An invisible barrier keeps anyone from touching the ship, stopping all physical contact about a finger's width away.
A strange, pale tentacle emerges from a hole in the deck, tapping rhythmically and moving only for living matter.
In the 18th century, Captain Kell threw a mysterious glowing egg overboard, plunging his crew into chaos and terror.
Kell watched his men step willingly into a sudden deck opening before disappearing into the ship's anomalous depths.
Foundation researcher Adler sends a D-Class worker in a hard suit down through the mysterious deck opening.
The worker discovers a massive living knot of nineteen trapped, ageless crew members and the source of the tentacle.
Adler eventually walks across the untouched deck and steps into the opening himself, joining those trapped outside of time.

clips.hook: A condemned inmate watches his hard suit get assembled
clips.text: A prisoner convicted of severe crimes watches impassively as workers weld together heavy diving equipment.

clips.hook: An eerie tentacle that makes no sound
clips.text: Researchers observe a strange appendage drumming silently against the wooden deck for centuries.

clips.hook: Water inside a supposedly dry ship hold
clips.text: A suited explorer wades through hip-deep water in a compartment that cameras previously showed completely empty.

clips.hook: Discovering a colossal rat king of human bodies
clips.text: An explorer down a shaft reports finding roughly twenty human bodies tangled together in a massive living knot.

clips.hook: The realization that the barrier is actually a door
clips.text: A researcher deduces that the ship's invisible force field is designed to trap living beings rather than keep them out.
